title: Hiring Mobile Analytics Engineer
description:
**Role:** Mobile Analytics Engineer  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Location:** Chennai / Pune  
**Payroll:** Haparz  
**Resume:** jansi@haparz.com

Role Overview

We are looking for a Mobile Analytics Engineer to troubleshoot mobile app tracking issues, validate attribution integrations, and ensure accurate event tracking across mobile applications and web journeys. The role involves hands-on debugging of Branch and Firebase SDKs, investigating tracking discrepancies, and coordinating with marketing, product, and technical teams to resolve issues.

Key Responsibilities

* Investigate tracking issues, including missing events, data mismatches, broken links, and attribution discrepancies.
* Reproduce user journeys across mobile apps and websites to identify tracking failures and funnel drop-offs.
* Test and debug deep links, tracking links, and mobile attribution configurations.
* Monitor Branch integrations with Meta, Google Ads, and other advertising partners; investigate disconnections and data gaps.
* Validate mobile SDKs and data layers before and after critical releases across different markets.
* Use Xcode and Android Studio to debug app behaviour and trace events through Branch and Firebase SDKs.
* Maintain documentation of tracking configurations, recurring issues, and resolutions.
* Collaborate with campaign specialists and technical teams, escalating complex issues that require architectural or cross-team changes.

Required Qualifications

* 3–6 years of experience in mobile analytics, app tracking, mobile attribution, or a related technical support role.
* Working knowledge of mobile measurement and attribution platforms, preferably Branch.
* Familiarity with Firebase, Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) app tracking.
* Practical exposure to Xcode and/or Android Studio for mobile debugging.
* Understanding of app tracking configurations for advertising platforms such as Meta and Google Ads.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to investigate issues systematically and explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Work Location: In person

We are looking for a Mobile App Testing Intern to join the Relyy project and assist our development team in testing Android and iOS mobile applications.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of software testing, mobile application testing, and automation testing using Appium. \* Create, maintain, and execute manual and automated test cases.

\* Develop and execute mobile automation scripts using \*\*Appium\*\*.

\* Test applications across different Android/iOS devices, screen sizes, and OS versions.

\* Identify, reproduce, document, and track application bugs.

\* Perform API testing and validate backend responses.

\* Conduct smoke, sanity, regression, and end-to-end testing before application releases.

\* Verify new features and bug fixes provided by the development team.

\* Maintain clear testing documentation, bug reports, and test results.

\* Work closely with developers to troubleshoot and reproduce issues.

\* Participate in release testing and application quality checks.

Mobile Automation

\* Appium

Testing & API Tools
